title: MUC Lobby Room Affiliation Check Bypass
description: Unauthorized users can bypass affiliation checks and access members-only rooms in Jitsi Meet
historic_cve_description: URI scheme authorization improper verification (adapted for Jitsi Meet context)

technical_details.vulnerability_pattern: Removal of authorization validation allows unauthorized access
technical_details.patch_description: Deletes the affiliation check block that validates room membership before allowing joins

exploitation.success_indicator: Unauthorized user successfully joins members-only room without error 407
